newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 298,900 MT were 1 percent above the previous week, but off 1 percent from the 4-week average. Major increases for Japan (81,000 MT), Taiwan (80,900 MT, mainly changed from unknown destinations), Mexico (67,200 MT), and South Korea (64,400 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (119,000 MT).

Exports of 289,700 MT were one-third below the previous week and 28 percent below the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Mexico (97,800 MT), Taiwan (84,900 MT), Japan (37,000 MT), and Spain (25,000 MT).
